revision_reason: Final pre-economic source correction: H1 ASK/BID extrema are not contemporaneous and only opens are compared; BTC source precision is two decimals; outcome-blind full-history profiles confine OHLC envelope normalization above one point to 2017-09 and ten crossed opens to 2017-11/12, strictly before BTC activation. Crossed opens after activation fail; inactive-only crossed bars receive one spread point for MT5 rate validity. Retained raw payloads are revalidated and rebound without returns or PnL access.
identity_reason: Fresh source/execution identity for the same preregistered weekly calendar-365 TSMOM mechanism; V4 remains immutable.

provider.name: Dukascopy Bank SA
provider.partial_h1_path: candles/trade/hour/{JETTA_CODE}/{BID_OR_ASK}?from={MONTH_START_EPOCH_MSC}; response is filtered to history_to_exclusive before encoding
provider.timestamp_basis: UTC epoch milliseconds decoded to aligned H1 UTC opens
provider.price_sides: separate H1 top-of-book BID and ASK OHLC

download.resume_boundary: hash-verified monthly BID/ASK raw JSON, AFRATE1 binary and month receipt
download.raw_retention: retain both official monthly BID and ASK JSON responses

rate_construction.provider_ohlc_geometry_normalization: Round every price to source point. Default: expand high/low by at most one source point to contain open/close. A symbol/month exception must be frozen in its row, bind an outcome-blind profile, and enforce both per-bar and corrected-bar-frequency caps; fail anything larger.
rate_construction.missing_active_symbol_at_decision_policy: fail the whole weekly snapshot and retry unchanged through Tuesday; never set one asset to zero
rate_construction.economic_use_limit: Only a weekly-open system with completed-D1 signals and no intraday exits, stops or filters may use this source identity.

2017-09.reason: Official Jetta BTC H1 legacy payload has a local delta-envelope defect; 2017-05 through 2026-08 outcome-blind profile found 17/462 BID bars (max 4 points) and 18/462 ASK bars (max 33 points) only in this month, with every other month zero.

symbols.activation_reason: first Monday after a complete 365-calendar-day warmup

source_acceptance.ask_open_not_below_corresponding_bid_ope: required at and after strategy_active_from; before activation only an explicitly profiled symbol exception may synthesize the frozen minimum spread and must report every raw crossing
source_acceptance.btc_geometry_exception: Only BTCUSD 2017-09 may exceed one point, capped at 50 points per bar and 5% corrected bars per side; all other BTC months use the one-point default.
source_acceptance.btc_preactivation_crossed_open_exception: The hash-bound profile found 10/75,613 crossed opens, all in 2017-11/12 and strictly before 2018-05-14 activation; those inactive bars receive one spread point only for MT5 rate validity. Any crossed open on/after activation fails the source contract.
source_acceptance.official_d1_session_crosscheck: Official Dukascopy D1 bars are session anchored (for FX observed at New York 17:00), not UTC-day bars. For every symbol, aggregate H1 BID inside consecutive official D1 session boundaries and match official D1 BID OHLC within one source point on at least 99.5% of common sessions.
source_acceptance.utc_signal_close_policy: The EA signal remains the last completed H1 BID close strictly before the UTC day boundary. It is not falsely compared with the provider's session-anchored D1 close.
source_acceptance.monday_availability: All active symbols have a current Monday H1 bar on at least 98% of expected DESIGN weeks; any missing weekly snapshot remains fail-closed.
source_acceptance.mt5_readback: Exact H1 bar count, first/last epoch, OHLC and spread readback after CustomRatesReplace.

frozen_splits.warmup: symbol history_from through 2017-12-31; BTC continues warming until 2018-05-13
